header.name: Robinson R22 Beta II geometry approximation

versionInfo.creator: ChatGPT, checked by DLR-SL
versionInfo.description: Original parametric approximation based on public Robinson R22 manufacturer dimensions. Contains cabin shell, tail boom, main rotor and tail rotor only. Not manufacturer CAD and not suitable for certification.

model.name: Robinson R22 Beta II
model.description: Low-fidelity external geometry model. Dimensions are in SI units and follow the CPACS coordinate convention: x aft, y right, z up.

fuselage.name: R22 cabin shell
fuselage.description: Rounded low-fidelity loft approximating the bubble cabin and aft cowling.

fuselage.name: R22 tail boom
fuselage.description: Tapered circular tail boom ending at the tail-rotor hub station.

rotorHub.name: R22 main rotor hub
rotorHub.description: Hub solids are not modeled; this node instantiates the rotor blades.

rotorHub.name: R22 tail rotor hub
rotorHub.description: Hub solids are not modeled; this node instantiates the rotor blades.

rotorBlade.name: R22 main rotor blade
rotorBlade.description: Wing-like CPACS rotor blade definition; radial direction is local +x.

fuselageProfile.name: R22 unit-diameter circular fuselage profile
fuselageProfile.description: Circular CPACS standard profile based on a superellipse. The unscaled profile has diameter 1, so section y/z scaling values represent full local width and height.

rotorAirfoil.name: NACA 0012 rotor airfoil (assumption)
rotorAirfoil.description: Symmetric NACA 4-digit profile used as a geometric placeholder; not claimed to be the manufacturer profile.
